run_cut_dataset_by_vad: run the cut function to split audio files into segments using VAD metadata and multiprocessing
run_cut_cli: run the CLI with --input_dir and --output_dir to cut audio dataset into small sequences using VAD files
create_cut_sequence: create segments from a single audio file by stitching VAD slices up to a target length in seconds
create_cut_book: create output segments for all chapters in a book directory by reading JSON metadata and cutting FLAC audio
create_save_segments: create and save stitched audio segments to disk as FLAC, WAV, or MP3 files at 16kHz sample rate
